scope: Semantic identity and observation-site audit only. This file does not assess implementation satisfaction and does not modify the property catalog.

atomic_propositions.name: gcs_heartbeat_gap_start
atomic_propositions.observation: Instrument the designated-GCS HEARTBEAT handler in the vehicle receipt clock or derive the edge from a complete controlled heartbeat trace. The aggregate last-seen state is shared with non-heartbeat refresh paths and is not an exact normative carrier.

bindings.semantic_identity: Accepted HEARTBEAT from a configured GCS system ID refreshes designated-GCS last-seen time.
bindings.evidence: Lines 4359-4363 test sysid_is_gcs and call sysid_mygcs_seen(AP_HAL::millis()).

bindings.semantic_identity: Current implementation conflict: accepted RC_CHANNELS_OVERRIDE refreshes the shared last-seen clock, but it is not a normative designated-GCS heartbeat event.
bindings.evidence: After GCS sysid validation and override application, line 4243 calls sysid_mygcs_seen(tnow). This path is retained to expose non-heartbeat interference, not as AP truth.

bindings.semantic_identity: Current implementation conflict: accepted MANUAL_CONTROL refreshes the shared last-seen clock, but it is not a normative designated-GCS heartbeat event.
bindings.evidence: Lines 7638-7647 validate GCS sysid and target; line 7655 records tnow as seen. This path is retained to expose non-heartbeat interference, not as AP truth.

bindings.semantic_identity: Shared implementation sink for aggregate GCS last-seen timestamps; it is not heartbeat-exclusive and therefore only models the normative heartbeat receipt state.
bindings.evidence: Lines 7662-7663 write GCS::_sysid_gcs_last_seen_time_ms and GCS_MAVLINK::_sysid_gcs_last_seen_time_ms for heartbeat and non-heartbeat producers.

bindings.semantic_identity: Elapsed interval since the shared implementation last-seen state; it can model but cannot exactly prove the normative designated-heartbeat gap.
bindings.evidence: Lines 133-141 read the aggregate timestamp and derive elapsed time and runtime timeout; the aggregate can include non-heartbeat refreshes.

unresolved: No explicit designated_gcs_heartbeat_gap_start object is stored; exact AP truth requires heartbeat-handler instrumentation or a complete controlled heartbeat trace.
The current shared implementation clock is also refreshed by accepted MANUAL_CONTROL and RC_CHANNELS_OVERRIDE. This is an implementation conflict, not a broader normative event set.
At last_gcs_update_ms == gcs_timeout_ms none of the four strict less-than/greater-than branches at events.cpp:144-158 is selected.

atomic_propositions.name: gcs_heartbeat_seen_before
atomic_propositions.observation: Derive designated-heartbeat history from the exact heartbeat consumer or a complete controlled input trace. The aggregate nonzero timestamp is only a model because non-heartbeat producers share it.

bindings.semantic_identity: Aggregate current-source last-seen field. It is not heartbeat-exclusive, so nonzero only models designated-heartbeat history.
bindings.evidence: GCS.h lines 1356-1359 define the aggregate field; heartbeat, RC override, and manual-control paths can write it.

bindings.semantic_identity: Aggregate implementation sentinel for no shared GCS refresh; it is not an exact sentinel for no designated heartbeat.
bindings.evidence: Lines 133-136 return when the aggregate last-seen timestamp is zero; non-heartbeat refreshes can make it nonzero.

bindings.semantic_identity: Shared aggregate write sink reached by the normative heartbeat handler and non-normative refresh paths; only a model for heartbeat-seen history.
bindings.evidence: This is the common sink reached by HEARTBEAT, RC_CHANNELS_OVERRIDE, and MANUAL_CONTROL consumers; exact heartbeat history must be separated upstream.

unresolved: The source implements seen-before as timestamp != 0 rather than an event count; an update received at boot-time value zero is not distinguishable by this sentinel.
A harness-derived normative count must include designated-GCS heartbeat receipts only and must not reclassify the two implementation-only refresh families as heartbeat events.
